summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the LIVALO (pitavastatin) NDA. The Summary Review states that because pitavastatin is the 8th statin submitted to the FDA and no significant efficacy or safety issues were identified during review, an advisory committee was not considered necessary. Consequently there is no committee vote, recommendation, or AC-driven change to the approval.
